title: San Diego Off Road Tours
includes: Guide-led trip lasting 2-4 hours with stops at various way-points
Exclusive use of one of our Land Cruisers
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
WE GUIDE, YOU DRIVE!

Drive one of our Land Cruisers vehicles on an off road trail in the Otay Wilderness area that borders Mexico and take in the views of San Diego and Tijuana from a unique perspective. 

We have three different trail options, ranging from beginner, intermediate to advanced, which are sure to give you the best outdoor experience while visiting San Diego.

We offer a four-wheeling experience like no other in San Diego. We are popular with experienced off-roaders and first-timers alike! Bring your rookie husbands, nervous wives, grandpas and girlfriends on a high-adventure, safe ride in a private vehicle with just your party.

While under the instruction of our experienced guides, you will join us on some of the best trails in San Diego and beyond. We will navigate high, steep climbs and heart-pounding descents, while taking in some of the most beautiful country around, all with the feeling of confidence and safety.
